blocks.text: This article describes how to add and manage departments. When you add administrators, you can define their scope by department. Administrators can have control over a set of users in a department. An administrator can belong to only one department.
Departments provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Manage admins and users based on their departments.
Categorize users based on departments specific to your organization.

blocks.text: On the Departments page (Administration > Authentication > Departments), you can do the following:

blocks.item: Import departments using a CSV file.
View the list of configured departments. For each department, you can see:
Name: The name of the department.
Description: A short description about the department.
